comment: Canonical, evidence-backed parameters for the Redmi K70 Ultra (rothko). Every value here must be traceable to an input listed in its evidence array. This file is the source for config/device-parameters.mk and config/product-parameters.mk; do not hand-edit the generated make fragments.

device.note: The stock init_boot build.prop labels its bootimage product as 'missi'; that is a vendor build label, not the K70 Ultra codename. fastboot product, odm_dlkm build.prop and the OTA post-build fingerprint all identify rothko/2407FRK8EC. Do not substitute 14T Pro, duchamp, vermeer or manet.
device.mixed_baseline_note: boot image is Android 16/SDK 36, but vendor/odm/dlkm and sepolicy are Android 14/SDK 34 with FCM target-level 8. Keep vendor API at 34; do not set 36.

architecture.note: armv8-2a is the conservative userspace baseline indicated by mgvi_64_armv82, not a maximum-ISA claim. Effective rothko vendor/ODM ABI properties and ODM ro.zygote select 64-bit apps only; generic ramdisk properties and CONFIG_COMPAT do not prove 32-bit app support. TARGET_2ND_ARCH=arm is retained independently for native dependency verification: an ELF32 Codec2 file exists, but the observed init service selects its separate -64b executable. No native ARM32 runtime support is claimed from file presence.

boot.note: Stock boot header v4 has no ramdisk; the generic ramdisk is in init_boot. Keep the stock kernel and its AVB footer unchanged.

init_boot.note: Stock init_boot is retained byte-for-byte. The exact supported flag is BOARD_PREBUILT_INIT_BOOT_IMAGE (verified in build/make/core/board_config.mk and Makefile); Lineage no longer builds a generic ramdisk here. The stock generic ramdisk init/overlay compatibility is a real risk and must be checked on a later build/boot baseline.
init_boot.compatibility_risk: stock generic ramdisk init/overlay behavior is not yet verified

vendor_boot.note: Keep the stock platform + recovery fragments and the DTBO container wrapping the base DTB. A standalone FDT is not interchangeable with the container.

dtbo.note: Stock dtbo container has one overlay entry; preserve it instead of regenerating overlays from another platform.

vendor.note: Vendor userspace is Android 14 / SDK 34; it is not rebuilt from Lineage sources. VINTF/SELinux compatibility with the Android 16 framework must be verified before enabling the build.

system_dlkm.note: Stock GKI modules must match the stock kernel; do not replace with modules built against a different kernel tree.

mi_ext.note: Checked: 5 APK, 1 JAR, 0 native .so/ELF, 0 VINTF, 10 Taiyi assets (124464825 bytes). Existing references are HyperOS framework/overlay content, not identified hardware drivers. Target does not mount mi_ext; phone partition is preserved. This does not prove that all Android functionality is independent of mi_ext.

super.layout_source: OTA payload metadata target layout; not a readback of current live super metadata or snapshot state
super.note: The live fastboot super size is 0x240000000 (9663676416). The payload group main is 9653190656; the 10485760-byte gap is not evidence of a live metadata layout. Re-check live metadata before any future flash/OTA plan.

virtual_ab.note: Values come from the OTA payload metadata. They are not a statement about the current snapshot/merge state.

slot_state.policy: Read-only state record only. This phase must not write, flash, erase, reboot or switch slots; slot b is marked unbootable and slot a is the only successful slot.

kernel.module_signing: stock kernel CONFIG_MODULE_SIG=y, CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_SHA1=y, force not set
kernel.note: Stock kernel and modules are kept matched. The kernel is based on Android 14 sources while the Lineage framework is Android 16; known kernel/vendor CVEs remain and are not fixed by this device tree.

avb.reason: The OEM private AVB keys are not available. Do not re-sign with test keys, do not claim we can sign stock images, and do not present generated images as flashable.
avb.scope: Offline build signing only; does not disable, alter or claim the phone AVB state.

ota.reason: Phase 1 produces no flashable OTA and no flash script.

mi_ext.reason: Content checked; no native driver/VINTF evidence. Target does not mount mi_ext; phone partition preserved. Do not assert all Android functionality is independent of mi_ext.
mi_ext.userdebug_note: A userdebug device build with prebuilt boot/init_boot/vendor_boot does not automatically adapt the mi_ext overlay. Target does not mount mi_ext; release readiness remains false.

build_plan.note: shipping API 34 is directly recorded as ro.product.first_api_level=34 in vendor/build.prop and the vendor ramdisk props. It matches the Android 14 / SDK 34 vendor base and is not copied from another MT6897 device.
build_plan.shipping_api_evidence: firmware/reports/inventory.json build_props: ro.product.first_api_level=34 in vendor/build.prop and vendor_ramdisk00/01 prop.default

init_boot.risk: The stock generic ramdisk keeps stock init/overlay behavior; init/overlay compatibility with the Lineage framework is not yet verified. Do not replace with a Lineage-built generic ramdisk in phase 1.

required_before_build: staged prebuilt boot/init_boot/vendor_boot/dtbo and stock vendor/odm/dlkm images (9 total; mi_ext excluded)
config/vendor-inventory.json with verified VINTF manifest/matrix and checkvintf result
config/vendor-inventory.json with enforcing SELinux policy hash and neverallow result
verified HAL inventory and kernel module match
mi_ext content check completed: no native driver/VINTF evidence; target not mounted; partition preserved; do not infer all Android functionality is independent
build-baseline VNDK 34 and linker namespace evidence; resolve 38 framework-provided candidates and 8 graphics/common/memtrack-tagged dependencies without assuming system_ext
module ABI/CRC evidence; runtime module load is a separate boot-test gate
stock init_boot generic ramdisk init/overlay compatibility check
forbidden: test-key AVB signing presented as stock signing
writing or switching slots on the live device
setting vendor API level 36 while the vendor stack is SDK 34 / FCM target-level 8
assuming system_ext resolves the 38 pending framework candidates or the 8 graphics/common/memtrack-tagged dependencies

vendor_integration.linker_namespace_status: unknown: no ld.config.txt/namespace search-path configuration was found in the acquired images
vendor_integration.status: incomplete: no checkvintf result, no neverallow result, 38 framework-provided candidate libraries pending baseline, 8 non-base-tagged dependencies unresolved, linker namespace unknown
vendor_integration.claim: not passed; do not assume system_ext resolves the framework candidates or the graphics/common/memtrack interface libraries
vendor_integration.required_extra_partitions_note: Empty only because unresolved framework candidates are pending baseline; not a claim that system_ext covers them.
vendor_integration.missing_nonbase_note: Mostly Android graphics/common/memtrack standard interface libraries; not evidence they are system_ext non-base libraries.

vndk_compatibility.note: Final VNDK 34 compatibility requires build-baseline system/system_ext/product artifacts and linker/namespace checks.

module_compatibility.note: same_magic(has_crcs) ignores the release prefix; all modules have __versions and module_layout CRC 0xea759d7f. Kernel symbol CRCs and runtime load remain unverified. Do not set vermagic string equality as a gate.

same_magic.note: The git hash difference alone is not a rejection reason when __versions is present.

module_compatibility.kernel_symbol_crc_table_status: not located in stripped Image.elf; __kcrctab may be present, absence not claimed

prebuilt_integrity.mi_ext_state: checked_no_native_driver_evidence; not staged; target not mounted; phone partition preserved
prebuilt_integrity.note: The vendor lane owns staging and the BOARD_PREBUILT_* flags. The device include is vendor/xiaomi/rothko/BoardConfigVendor.mk. The vendor gate keeps ROTHKO_HARDWARE_RELEASE_READY=false; a staged hash is not a compatibility or bootability claim.

unknowns: module runtime load and kernel symbol CRC compatibility
VINTF checkvintf and SELinux neverallow results
actual dumpvars, final-image app ABI properties and selected zygote64 startup script consistency
native ARM32 runtime dependency/provider and namespace closure; secondary build architecture is not app support
mi_ext runtime necessity/overlay adaptation unproven; content checked with no native driver evidence
release_readiness.note: Compilation gates may be open for configuration and systemimage; this does not make the device release-ready.
